items.definition:
a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft
The pilot announced that we were about to land.

a building where plays are performed
We went to the theatre to see a play.

a type of hat; a lid
He wore a baseball cap.

the period of being a child
She had a happy childhood.

a humorous play or film
We watched a funny comedy last night.

a synthetic material
This bottle is made of plastic.

a district, especially one forming a community within a town or city
Our neighborhood is very quiet.

the joint connecting the arm or forelimb to the trunk
He carried the bag on his shoulder.

a brief fall of rain; an act of washing oneself in a shower
I'm going to take a shower.

a tall, narrow building or part of a building
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.

circular part that turns
The car has four wheels.

a scheduled meeting
I have an appointment with the doctor at 3 PM.

a shrub or small tree
There's a rose bush growing by the fence.

a main road
The highway was busy with traffic.

a unit of length (2.54 cm)
The snail moved an inch at a time.

a large, frightening creature
The child was afraid of the monster under his bed.

a person who speaks; a device that produces sound
The speaker gave an interesting presentation.

a subject of discussion
We discussed many interesting topics.

a person visiting a place or person
We had a visitor come to our house today.

a stringed musical instrument
He loves to play the guitar.

a single leg covering (usually plural 'pants')
The pant leg was torn.

a small bag sewn into clothing
He put his keys in his pocket.

a hard, rigid form of connective tissue constituting most of the skeleton of vertebrates
The dog buried its bone in the garden.

a movable barrier in a fence or wall
Please close the gate when you leave.

a reflective surface, typically glass coated with a metallic amalgam
She looked at herself in the mirror.

an exciting or unusual experience
Going on a safari was a great adventure.

the part of the body between the waist and the top of the thigh
She put her hands on her hips and smiled.

an object or set of objects wrapped or packed in a container
I received a package in the mail today.

complete absence of sound
There was a moment of silence before the announcement.

a female actor
She dreams of becoming a famous actress.

a large fortified building or set of buildings
We visited an old castle on our trip.

the study of numbers, shapes, and quantities
My favorite subject in school is math.

the official residence of a sovereign, archbishop, bishop, or other exalted person
The Queen lives in a beautiful palace.

happiness
Her happiness was evident in her smile.

mood
He's in a good mood today.

a loose granular substance
The children played in the sand.

a dark area or shape produced by an object blocking light
The tree cast a long shadow.

a narrow strip of material
Please pass me the sticky tape.

a form of energy
The house lost electricity during the storm.

a person who owns or manages a farm
The farmer harvested the crops.

a gymnasium
I go to the gym three times a week.

a strip of material worn around the waist
He tightened his belt after eating too much.

a team sport played on ice or a field
Ice hockey is very popular in Canada.

laboratory
We conducted the experiment in the science lab.

organ for digestion
My stomach hurts after eating too much.

rubbish, waste
Please take out the trash.

a child of one's aunt or uncle
My cousin is coming to visit next week.

fine powder of earth or other matter
The old books were covered in dust.

a cutting tool
Be careful with that sharp knife.

a person who reads
She is an avid reader of fantasy novels.

a close friend
He's my best buddy from college.

an expression of praise for an achievement or good wishes on a special occasion
She received a congratulation for her excellent work.

a very dry, empty area of land
The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.

a round container
She cooked the soup in a large pot.

a large piece of thin material
Please put clean sheets on the bed.

thin cord
He tied the package with a piece of string.

a holiday
We are planning a vacation to the beach.

an insect or a sport
We heard a cricket chirping outside.

a door or gate by which you can enter a place
The main entrance is on the left.

the state of being friends
Their friendship lasted for many years.

cosmetics applied to the face to improve or change the appearance
She put on some makeup before going out.

a metal disk given as an award
He won a gold medal in the Olympics.

a metal container used for cooking
Heat the oil in a frying pan.

the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean
We found a beautiful shell on the beach.
